pairs: A finibus terræ ad te clamavi,
I cried out to you from the ends of the earth.
When my heart was in anguish,
you exalted me on a rock.
for you have been my hope,
a tower of strength before the face of the enemy.
Inhabitabo in tabernaculo tuo in sæcula;
I will dwell in your tabernacle forever.
I will be protected under the cover of your wings.
You have granted an inheritance to those who fear your name.
You will add days to the days of the king,
annos ejus usque in diem generationis
even to the time of generation after generation.
Permanet in æternum in conspectu Dei:
Who will long for his mercy and truth?
Sic psalmum dicam nomini tuo in sæculum sæculi,
So I will compose a psalm to your name, forever and ever,
ut reddam vota mea de die in diem.
so that I may repay my vows from day to day.
